supporting_observations.claim: The domain account ext.rwong was created at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake, matching the organization's stated ext.<name> temporary-account naming practice and an account-creation role assigned to help desk.
Within seconds of creation, ext.rwong was added to the Freelancers group, the only group specified for temporary accounts.
The account-creation event references the same logon ID as a network logon by nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01 shortly beforehand.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show the account-creation and group-membership changes but do not establish the business request or approval for creating ext.rwong.
The records do not establish whether nora.blake personally initiated the changes or whether the account or workstation was compromised.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was requested and approved for a legitimate temporary engagement.
Whether the credentials or session used by nora.blake were under her control at the time.
Whether ext.rwong received privileges or access beyond the group membership shown in the available records.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe started under nora.blake on WS-NBLAKE-01, despite the inventory stating there is no VPN and remote administration is only done from WS-SOKAFOR-01. Treat this as a separate review; it does not by itself indicate the alerted account creation was malicious. Records: T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011.
